commands: set -euo pipefail; echo LOCAL_AGENT_OK; printf 'PWD='; pwd; printf 'HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD; ADB=/opt/homebrew/bin/adb; test -x "$ADB"; "$ADB" devices -l; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; STATE="$("$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" get-state 2>/dev/null || true)"; echo PHONE_STATE=$STATE; test "$STATE" = device; printf 'PHONE_MODEL='; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r'; printf 'ANDROID_VERSION='; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.build.version.release | tr -d '\r'; printf 'SDK='; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.build.version.sdk | tr -d '\r'
